name: Harley-Davidson WL 45 Flathead
engine: 45 cubic inch (750 cc) air-cooled side-valve V-twin, single carb
intro: The 45 flathead, including the WLA army bike. Simple side-valve engine, hand shift and foot clutch.

add.title: Record the engine and frame numbers
add.instructions: Photograph and write down the engine case number. Military WLA bikes and civilian WLs have different number formats.
add.reason: Numbers tell you what the bike really is, which matters for parts and value.

H: A flathead has its valves in the cylinder. Valve work means lifting the heads and cylinders, not a quick shim check.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
